008package paint.fiji.trackmate;
009
010import java.time.Duration;
011
012/**
013 * Immutable container for the results of a TrackMate analysis.
014 * <p>
015 * Encapsulates statistics such as the number of detected spots,
016 * total and filtered tracks, number of analyzed frames, and
017 * runtime duration.
018 * </p>
019 */
020public class TrackMateResults {
021    private final boolean  success;
022    private final boolean  calculationPerformed;
023    private final int      numberOfSpots;
024    private final int      numberOfTracks;
025    private final int      numberOfFilteredTracks;
026    private final int      numberOfFrames;
027    private final Duration duration;
028    private final int      numberOfSpotsInAllTracks;
029
030
031    /**
032     * Constructs a {@code TrackMateResults} instance with only a success flag.
033     * Assumes no calculations were performed and sets all numeric fields to zero.
034     *
035     * @param success whether the analysis succeeded
036     */
037    public TrackMateResults(boolean success) {
038        this(success, false, 0, 0, 0, 0, null, 0);
039    }
040
041    /**
042     * Constructs a fully detailed {@code TrackMateResults} instance.
043     *
044     * @param success                true if the analysis succeeded
045     * @param calculationPerformed   true if processing was executed
046     * @param numberOfSpots          number of detected spots
047     * @param numberOfTracks         total number of identified tracks
048     * @param numberOfFilteredTracks number of tracks after filtering
049     * @param numberOfFrames         total number of frames analyzed
050     * @param duration               runtime duration of analysis
051     * @param numberOfSpotsInAllTracks total number of spots in all tracks
052     */
053    public TrackMateResults(boolean success,
054                            boolean calculationPerformed,
055                            int numberOfSpots,
056                            int numberOfTracks,
057                            int numberOfFilteredTracks,
058                            int numberOfFrames,
059                            Duration duration,
060                            int numberOfSpotsInAllTracks) {
061        this.success                  = success;
062        this.calculationPerformed     = calculationPerformed;
063        this.numberOfSpots            = numberOfSpots;
064        this.numberOfTracks           = numberOfTracks;
065        this.numberOfFilteredTracks   = numberOfFilteredTracks;
066        this.numberOfFrames           = numberOfFrames;
067        this.duration                 = duration;
068        this.numberOfSpotsInAllTracks = numberOfSpotsInAllTracks;
069    }
070
071    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
072    // Getters
073    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
074
075    /**
076     * @return true if the analysis completed successfully
077     */
078    public boolean isSuccess() {
079        return success;
080    }
081
082    /**
083     * @return true if the calculation was performed
084     */
085    public boolean isCalculationPerformed() {
086        return calculationPerformed;
087    }
088
089    /**
090     * @return total number of detected spots
091     */
092    public int getNumberOfSpots() {
093        return numberOfSpots;
094    }
095
096    /**
097     * @return number of tracks that passed filtering
098     */
099    public int getNumberOfFilteredTracks() {
100        return numberOfFilteredTracks;
101    }
102
103    /**
104     * @return number of frames analyzed
105     */
106    public int getNumberOfFrames() {
107        return numberOfFrames;
108    }
109
110    /**
111     * @return duration of the analysis, or {@code null} if unavailable
112     */
113    public Duration getDuration() {
114        return duration;
115    }
116
117    /**
118     * @return number of spots across all tracks
119     */
120    public int getNumberOfSpotsInAllTracks() {
121        return numberOfSpotsInAllTracks;
122    }
123
124    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
125    // Representation
126    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
127
128    /**
129     * Returns a formatted summary string containing all key metrics.
130     *
131     * @return a string summarizing TrackMate run results
132     */
133    @Override
134    public String toString() {
135        return String.format(
136                "Success: %b, Spots: %d, Tracks: %d, Filtered: %d, Frames: %d, Duration(ms): %d",
137                success,
138                numberOfSpots,
139                numberOfTracks,
140                numberOfFilteredTracks,
141                numberOfFrames,
142                duration != null ? duration.toMillis() : 0
143        );
144    }
145}
